key.name: enabled
key.description: When off, every charm is hidden and all animation work stops.

key.name: preset
key.description: Selecting a preset writes its layout into the cords key. Editing any cord switches to custom.

key.name: cords
key.description: Up to 5 cords: (position across the bar 0–1, rope length in pixels, rope style id, 1–3 charm ids from the top down).

key.name: custom-cords
key.description: Restored when the Custom preset is selected.

key.name: charm-size
key.description: Diameter of a lone charm. Stacked charms are drawn a little smaller.

key.name: rope-thickness
key.description: Scales the width each rope style is drawn at.

key.name: shadow
key.summary: Draw a soft shadow under ropes
key.description: A faint offset stroke that separates ropes from the windows behind them.

key.name: breeze-enabled
key.description: Every 45–120 seconds a short gust sways the charms.

key.name: breeze-on-battery
key.summary: Keep the breeze on battery power
key.description: By default the breeze pauses while the laptop runs on battery.

key.name: breeze-strength
key.description: How far a gust pushes the charms.

key.name: grab-modifier
key.description: Charms let clicks pass through to windows unless this modifier is held.

key.name: grab-without-super
key.summary: Grab charms without holding the modifier
key.description: When on, charms always catch clicks. Clicks on ropes and empty space still reach windows.

key.name: respect-reduced-motion
key.description: When system animations are disabled, charms hang still: no breeze, no nudges and no initial swing. Dragging still works.

key.name: active-cord
key.summary: Cord selected in the preferences Library
key.description: Internal: remembers which cord the Library page edits.
